name: Тень Шёлковых шапочек
notes: A shadow of the Шёлковые шапочки, Мирайя's scout and poisoner, a generic type fought alone. A shadow goes first and is seen last. It watches the meeting place and carries messages; in a fight it works from the dark with a blowgun and a poisoned dagger, and keeps a smoke ball for the way out. It carries a darkvision elixir for nights like this one. Human ancestry is assigned for play, not canon. Table note: Spry Dodge is a toggle for the triggering attack.

standardItems.text: The shadow deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] creatures.

actions.name: Quick Toxin
actions.text: The shadow applies a dose of injury poison it carries to the dagger it holds or to a blowgun dart. If the poison's DC is lower than 22, it uses DC 22 instead.

actions.name: Smoke and Gone
actions.text: The shadow smashes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Smoke Ball (Lesser)] on the ground, filling a @Template[type:burst|distance:5] centered on one corner of its space with thick smoke for 1 minute. Creatures inside the smoke are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed], and all other creatures are concealed to them. The shadow then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Hide]{Hides} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Sneak]{Sneaks}.

actions.name: Spry Dodge
actions.text:
Trigger The shadow is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker it can see

Effect The shadow gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the shadow can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Step].

actions.name: Slink in Shadows
actions.text: The shadow can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Hide] or end its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Sneak] in a creature's or object's shadow.
